{{Current events|year=2018|month=11|day=13|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Amazon HQ2]]
**[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] announces it will split their second headquarters in [[New York]] and [[National Landing]] in [[Northern Virginia|northern Virginia]] (outside [[Washington D.C.]]) [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/11/13/tech/amazon-hq2-nyc-arlington/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[CNN]] files a lawsuit against the Trump administration, claiming its revocation of reporter [[Jim Acosta]]'s press pass on November 7 violated their [[First Amendment to the United States Constitution|First]] and [[Fifth Amendment to the United States Constitution|Fifth]] Amendment rights. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/cnn-sues-white-house-to-regain-access-for-reporter-jim-acosta/2018/11/13/afc3423c-e6bf-11e8-bbdb-72fdbf9d4fed_story.html?utm_term=.de883dbd108e (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Sri Lanka]] reverses [[President of Sri Lanka|President]] [[Maithripala Sirisena]]'s decisions to dissolve [[Parliament of Sri Lanka|Parliament]] and to hold snap elections. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/11/sri-lanka-supreme-court-overturns-dissolution-parliament-181113125340789.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom]] says that UK and EU negotiators reached a draft agreement and that it will be discussed by [[Cabinet of the United Kingdom|Cabinet]] tomorrow. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/uk-cabinet-meet-britain-eu-reach-draft-brexit-59165929 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[2026 Winter Olympics]]
**Residents of the city of [[Calgary]] head to the polls to vote on a non-binding [[Referendum|plebiscite]] to determine if the city should make a bid to host the 2026 Winter Olympic Games. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/sports/non-binding-vote-today-on-hosting-olympics-in-calgary-1.4174709 (CTV News)]
*[[First Lady of the United States]] [[Melania Trump]] calls for the ouster of [[Deputy National Security Advisor (United States)|Deputy National Security Advisor]] [[Mira Ricardel]]. [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2018/11/13/melania-trump-says-bolton-deputy-should-be-ousted.html (''Toronto Star'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-ricardel/trump-considers-ousting-national-security-deputy-over-feud-with-first-lady-sources-idUSKCN1NI2IL (Reuters)]
